metadata.title: Retail Lending Business Workbench
metadata.description: An interactive workspace for customer screening, document intake, interview structuring, profiling, product matching, outreach, materials, and follow-ups.

workspace.title: Business Workbench
workspace.description: Choose a module and start working. This version provides an interactive front-end demonstration; AI and credit outputs still require manager review.

modules.title: Customer ledger and screening
modules.description: Prioritize customers by operating activity, loan status, maturity, and follow-up interval.

modules.title: Intelligent interview management
modules.description: Turn unstructured notes into needs, concerns, and open questions.

modules.title: Document & statement OCR
modules.description: Extract document and statement fields and review low-confidence results.

modules.title: Unified customer profile
modules.description: Maintain customer, business, bank relationship, external credit, and current-needs data.

modules.title: Product matching
modules.description: Show product directions, match rationale, and conditions based on reviewed information.

modules.title: Intelligent outreach scripts
modules.description: Create editable scripts for calls, messages, meetings, and objections.

modules.title: Materials & follow-up management
modules.description: Track document completeness, customer feedback, next tasks, and reminders together.

modules.title: One-click summary
modules.description: Assemble the interview, profile, match, scripts, materials, and next actions.

interview.sample: The customer runs a neighborhood grocery store with daily revenue of about RMB 18,000. They seek RMB 500,000 for peak-season inventory over 12 months. The customer owns a home, has not confirmed collateral preference, and cares about speed and flexible repayment.
interview.empty: After editing the notes, select Structure interview notes.

outputs.value: Current liabilities, collateral preference, and complete six-month statements

matching.customer_summary: RMB 500,000 working capital · 12 months · Speed is important · Security pending

products.label: Primary direction
products.title: Small-business unsecured facility
products.reason: Stable cash flow, a good settlement relationship, and no current business loan support priority assessment of an unsecured direction.
products.condition: Complete six-month statements, credit authorization, and current liability details are still required.

products.label: Alternative direction
products.title: Property-secured business facility
products.reason: The customer owns a home, creating an alternative if the unsecured amount does not meet the need.
products.condition: Property ownership, collateral preference, and valuation must be confirmed.

matching.disclaimer: Matching is for business assistance only. Amount, rate, term, and approval remain subject to the formal credit process.

scenarios.title: First phone call
scenarios.content: Hello Mr. Lin, I am your relationship manager. We noticed that your recent operating cash flow has been stable and wanted to understand whether you have peak-season inventory funding needs. I can first help structure possible directions based on your business. Final amount and terms remain subject to formal approval.

scenarios.title: Message follow-up
scenarios.content: Hello Mr. Lin. I have summarized the RMB 500,000 inventory need discussed today. The next step is to add six months of operating statements and current liability details. I will explain the assessable product directions after reviewing the documents.

scenarios.title: Objection handling
scenarios.content: I understand that processing time is important. We can first organize the core documents and need in one pass to reduce repeated requests. Actual timing will still depend on document completeness and the formal approval process.

materials.progress_text: {complete} of {total} items complete. Select an item to update completeness.

sections.title: Customer need
sections.content: RMB 500,000 in peak-season working capital for 12 months, with a focus on funding speed and repayment flexibility.

sections.title: Product direction
sections.content: Primary: micro-business unsecured loan. Alternative: property-secured business loan. Final terms remain subject to approval.

sections.title: Missing materials
sections.content: Add premises evidence, loan-purpose documents, and current liabilities, then verify six months of statement completeness.

sections.title: Next action
sections.content: Confirm collateral preference, send the document checklist, and refresh the product match after all materials arrive.

summary.action_description: Save the structured result for outreach, document collection, and follow-up execution.
